activity.notes: Karib'il Watar is securely attested epigraphically as a Sabaean mukarrib, but his absolute chronology is debated. ATLAS uses c.680 BCE only as a representative early-seventh-century attestation point rather than inventing a precise reign interval.

sources.title: Quelques épisodes marquants de l'histoire sudarabique — Persée
sources.citation_text: The study discusses Karib'il Watar, son of Dhamar'ali, as mukarrib of Saba and places him in the first half of the seventh century BCE if the Assyrian synchronism is accepted.
